submitted.rationale: XRD shows a single rutile-type (In,Sb)O2/InSbO4 phase from Sb≈0.5 to 0.72 (peaks at Q 1.87/2.37/2.65/3.55). At Sb=0.22 bixbyite In2O3 also appears, and the In11Sb3O24 phase predicted there did not form. The 2.4 eV photons are near or below the band gap, so all EQE values are tiny. EQE measured across the rutile region peaked at Sb=0.653 (0.0116%), compared with 0.0069% at 0.51 and 0.0063% at 0.75.
